zh: 软件数学模式切换下的配对GEMM耗时比。(a) A100；(b) T4；(c) RTX 5070。每台设备内固定矩阵输入、规模及输入输出dtype，仅切换矩阵乘法的TF32许可设置。三个轮次分别采用禁止—允许—禁止、允许—禁止—允许和禁止—允许—禁止的阶段顺序。每阶段20个窗口，每窗口10次GEMM，以CUDA Event测得的窗口时间除以10；先取阶段窗口中位数，再将同一设置的重复阶段取几何平均，得到R=T_off/T_on。三个标记为三轮R，黑色短线为三轮中位数；虚线R=1表示两设置耗时相同，R>1表示允许TF32时更快。纵轴为以2为底的对数轴。窗口用于描述同轮稳定性，不作为独立硬件重复；图中不提供显著性推断。各设备的软件环境不同，跨设备效应幅度不能单独归因于架构。RTX 5070在实际Windows桌面环境测量，进程库存快照不能排除后台GPU活动。TF32许可设置不等于直接确认某个内核被执行；恢复比与CPU float64输出差异另行报告。
en: Paired GEMM timing ratios under changes in the backend mathematical mode. (a) A100; (b) T4; (c) RTX 5070. Within each device, matrix inputs, dimensions and input/output dtypes were fixed while only the TF32 permission for matrix multiplication was changed. The three rounds used off–on–off, on–off–on and off–on–off sequences. Each phase comprised 20 windows of 10 GEMM calls; CUDA Event window times were divided by 10. Phase medians were computed first, and repeated phases with the same setting were combined geometrically to obtain R=T_off/T_on. Symbols show the three round-level ratios and black segments their median. The dashed line at R=1 indicates equal timings; R>1 indicates faster execution when TF32 was permitted. The y axis uses a base-2 logarithmic scale. Windows describe within-round stability and are not independent hardware replicates; no significance inference is shown. Software stacks differ across devices, so between-device effect magnitudes do not isolate architecture. RTX 5070 measurements used the actual Windows desktop environment; process-inventory snapshots cannot exclude background GPU activity. Permitting TF32 does not directly confirm execution of a particular kernel. Recovery ratios and CPU float64 output differences are reported separately.
